'''Jiang Zejia''' ({{lang-zh|s=江泽佳|t=江澤佳|p=Jiāng Zéjiā}}; November 1920 – 10 November 2013) was a Chinese electrical engineer and educator.<ref>{{cite news |date=2013-11-20 |title= |script-title=zh:追忆往事 缅怀功绩 传承精神——重庆大学举行缅怀江泽佳老先生座谈会 |url=http://news.cqu.edu.cn/news/article/article_57431.html |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304120530/http://news.cqu.edu.cn/news/article/article_57431.html |archivedate=2016-03-04 |newspaper=[[Chongqing University]] |language=zh}}</ref>

==Biography==
Jiang was born in November 1920 in [[Hankou]], [[Hubei]], with his ancestral home in [[Jingde County]], [[Anhui]].<ref name=obituary/> After the high school, he studied, then taught, at what is now [[Chongqing University]]. He went to study at [[McGill University]] in [[Canada]] in 1947.{{citation needed|date=August 2024}}

He returned to China in 1948 and that year joined the Department of Electrical Engineering faculty of Chongqing University, he was promoted to professor in 1951. In 1951 Chongqing University appointed him director of its Electrical Engineering Department. In 1982, he became [[President of Chongqing University]], serving until 1986. On November 10, 2013, he died of illness in the [[Chongqing Medical University|First Affiliated Hospital of Chongqing Medical University]].<ref name="obituary">{{cite news |date=2013-11-10 |title=Jiang Zejia's obituary |url=http://news.cqu.edu.cn/news/article/article_56963.html |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304131317/http://news.cqu.edu.cn/news/article/article_56963.html |archivedate=2016-03-04 |newspaper=[[Chongqing University]] |language=zh}}</ref>
